name: Sankosh

source.name: Northern Bhutan (Punakha, confluence of Mo Chhu and Pho Chhu)

significance: forms much of the Assam-West Bengal state boundary after entering India
known as Gangadhar in the Assam plains below Srirampur
site of the Punatsangchhu I & II hydroelectric projects in Bhutan
did_you_know: Known as the Puna Tsang Chu through most of Bhutan and the Gangadhar once it reaches the Assam plains, the Sankosh carries three different names across its short course.
After crossing from Bhutan into India, the Sankosh runs along the boundary between Assam and West Bengal before it finally joins the Brahmaputra.
